dict.string: Panes uses an administrator prompt only when you enable lid-close sleep prevention without the background helper.
Panes opens repositories and terminals in the folders you choose, including ones on your Desktop.
Panes opens repositories and terminals in the folders you choose, including ones in Documents.
Panes opens repositories and terminals in the folders you choose, including ones in Downloads.
Panes opens repositories and terminals on external drives when you choose a folder there.
Panes opens repositories and terminals on network volumes when you choose a folder there.
